--  Code generated by @uarp/codegen from spec/openapi.json. DO NOT EDIT.
--
--  Data models. Optional properties carry a `Has_` flag beside the value,
--  so every record can be default-initialised and compared with `=`.

with Ada.Containers.Vectors;

with UARP.JSON_Support;
with UARP.Types;

package UARP.Models is

   use UARP.Types;

   subtype JSON_Value is UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;

   --  An API key. Documented at https://docs.test/keys.
   type Key is record
      --  uarp_<prefix>_<secret>; store and use as Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
      Value : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      --  Free text. May contain [brackets], <angles> and a link like https://docs.test/notes.
      Has_Note : Boolean := False;
      Note : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
   end record;

   function To_JSON (Model : Key) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;
   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Key;

   package Key_Vectors is new Ada.Containers.Vectors
     (Index_Type => Positive, Element_Type => Key);

   --  `ListKeysResponse` model.
   type List_Keys_Response is record
      Items : UARP.Models.Key_Vectors.Vector;
   end record;

   function To_JSON (Model : List_Keys_Response) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;
   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return List_Keys_Response;

end UARP.Models;

==> src/generated/uarp-models.adb <==
--  Code generated by @uarp/codegen from spec/openapi.json. DO NOT EDIT.

package body UARP.Models is

   package JS renames UARP.JSON_Support;

   function To_JSON (Model : Key) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value is
      Result : constant UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := JS.New_Object;
   begin
      JS.Set (Result, "value", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Value));
      if Model.Has_Note then
         JS.Set (Result, "note", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Note));
      end if;
      return Result;
   end To_JSON;

   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Key is
      Result : Key;
   begin
      if JS.Present (Node, "value") then
         Result.Value := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "value"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "note") then
         Result.Has_Note := True;
         Result.Note := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "note"));
      end if;
      return Result;
   end From_JSON;

   function To_JSON (Model : List_Keys_Response) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value is
      Result : constant UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := JS.New_Object;
   begin
      declare
         Items : JS.JSON_Array := JS.JSON.Empty_Array;
      begin
         for Element of Model.Items loop
            JS.JSON.Append (Items, To_JSON (Element));
         end loop;
         JS.Set (Result, "items", Items);
      end;
      return Result;
   end To_JSON;

   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return List_Keys_Response is
      Result : List_Keys_Response;
   begin
      if JS.Present (Node, "items") then
         declare
            Items : constant JS.JSON_Array := JS.Get_Array (Node, "items");
         begin
            for Index in 1 .. JS.JSON.Length (Items) loop
               Result.Items.Append (From_JSON (JS.JSON.Get (Items, Index)));
            end loop;
         end;
      end if;
      return Result;
   end From_JSON;

end UARP.Models;
